AccountId.description: Unique identifier of the account (`Customer` or `Company`) the bill is issued to.

AccountType.title: Account type
AccountType.description:
A discriminator specifying the [type of account](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/accounts/#account-type), i.e. `Customer` or `Company`.

Company

Customer

CustomerId.description: Unique identifier of the `Customer` the bill is issued to.

CompanyId.description: Unique identifier of the `Company` specified in `CompanyDetails` or the `Company` the bill is issued to.

AssociatedAccountIds.description: Unique identifiers of the `Customers` or `Companies` that are associated to the bill.

CreatedUtc.description: Date and time of the bill creation in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

IssuedUtc.description: Date and time of the bill issuance in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

TaxedUtc.description: Taxation date of the bill in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

PaidUtc.description: Date when the bill was paid in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

DueUtc.description: Bill due date and time in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

LastReminderDateUtc.description: Date and time when an email reminder to pay an invoice was last sent, in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Date and time when the bill was last updated, in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

PurchaseOrderNumber.description: Unique number of the purchase order from the buyer.

OrderItems.description: The order items (consumed items such as nights or products) on the bill.

PaymentItems.description: The payment items (such as cash, credit card payments or invoices) on the bill.

OwnerData.title: Bill owner data
OwnerData.description: Additional information about owner of the bill. Can be a `Customer` or `Company`. Persisted at the time of closing of the bill.

CompanyDetails.title: Bill company data
CompanyDetails.description: Additional information about the company assigned to the bill. Not the same as the owner. Persisted at the time of closing of the bill.

AssociatedAccountData.description: Additional information about the associated account of the bill. Can be a `Customer` or `Company`. Persisted at the time of closing of the bill. Currently only one account can be associated with a bill, but this may be extended in future.

EnterpriseData.title: Bill enterprise data
EnterpriseData.description: Additional information about the enterprise issuing the bill, including bank account details. Persisted at the time of closing of the bill.

CorrectionState.title: Bill correction state
CorrectionState.description:
Whether the bill is a regular bill or a corrective bill.

Bill (Regular bill.)

CorrectiveBill (Corrective bill, i.e. the `CorrectionType` is either `Edit`, `Cancellation`, or `ReceivablePaymentsBalance`.)
x-enumDescriptions: Corrective bill, i.e. the `CorrectionType` is either `Edit`, `Cancellation`, or `ReceivablePaymentsBalance`.

CorrectionType.description:
Type of correction.

Cancellation

Edit

CreditNote

Reinstatement

ReceivablePaymentsBalance

CorrectedBillId.description: The ID of the bill that the corrective bill corrects. If the corrected bill was deleted, this field is `null`.
